purpose: Define the runtime's internal, fast, human-readable lineup plan display for target lineups, live-ranking lineups, transition plans, next-pivot plans, and self-board placement. The product emits text boards and tactical move lists only.

external_code_paths.policy: Do not generate, reverse engineer, upload, publish, or automate external lineup codes from the runtime hot path.

cli_display_policy.row_offset_policy: Rows 1 and 3 start at the left edge; rows 2 and 4 are indented by half a cell to match the in-game staggered board.
cli_display_policy.cell_policy: Every board cell uses the same compact hex frame. Unit names are centered inside the cell. Items, star level, and move reasons are rendered below the board.
cli_display_policy.positioning_advice_policy: For self-board placement, first list only units that need to move, then give a short tactical reason. Do not claim opponent-specific counter-positioning unless the user supplied the opponent facts manually.

mechanical_rendering_policy.hard_rule: Runtime/strategy/AI layers should emit structured lineup_plan only. The CLI board must be produced by tools/render-jcc-lineup-text-board.mjs and embedded verbatim by the host model.
